description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Soliton that is an artifact.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by paying {U}, untapping it.

Repeat from step 2.
